description: Trades between the app's users (C170: neblla.db.offer / acceptOffer; what is tradable is neblla_update_app({ trade })). Action "list": the log, newest first, with { user? (their id in the app), status? (pending | done | declined | cancelled | expired | failed | all, the default), limit?, offset? } → { trades, total }; each trade has from, to, give, get (items { table, id } or { product, amount }), status, reason (why it failed or was cancelled), createdAt, expiresAt, closedAt. Action "cancel" { id }: take a pending offer back (support, abuse); both users hear it. A trade that was done is not undone from here.

env.description: "pro" (the published app) or "pre" (its test copy: pre's config, on pre's data, its own unless it plays with pro's). Left out: where the app is, its chosen environment (neblla_promote "status": target, "pro" by default). The pre id (_<id>) as appId is the same as env "pre"

name: neblla_trades
